source: Calculated by Publick from the Connecticut Office of Policy and Management's mill rates and the statewide Parcel and CAMA file

years.calculated: The average assessed value of 14,284 single-family homes in the state's 2024 parcel file, times the fiscal year 2025 mill rate. Connecticut assesses homes at 70% of market value. It's the bill before exemptions and credits.

The average assessed value of 14,301 single-family homes in the state's 2025 parcel file, times the fiscal year 2026 mill rate. Connecticut assesses homes at 70% of market value. It's the bill before exemptions and credits.

The average assessed value of 14,332 single-family homes in the state's 2026 parcel file, times the fiscal year 2027 mill rate. Connecticut assesses homes at 70% of market value. It's the bill before exemptions and credits.
